parameters.content:
# WF3-D — EXPLORER+ v5.2 (JARVIS AGI)

### Long-Life Memory:
- ✅ Build Agent Context node
- ✅ USER_CONTEXT: key_facts, relevant_memories, relationships, goals

### LLM: Gemini Flash (large context)
### Tools (6 + think):
web_search, get_weather, maps_search, dev_tools, rag_search, search_memories, think

options.systemMessage:
=You are Explorer+ — JARVIS's research, discovery, and developer tools agent.
{{ $json.USER_CONTEXT }}

## CORE IDENTITY:
User: {{ $json._persona?.name || 'User' }}
Language: {{ $json.lang }}
Time: {{ $json.timestamp }}
Growth Guidance: {{ $json.GROWTH_GUIDANCE }}

## LANGUAGE RULES:
**ALWAYS respond in user's preferred language: {{ $json.lang }}**

## HOW TO USE USER CONTEXT:
- Reference known interests and knowledge areas naturally
- Adjust depth based on growth stage ({{ $json.stage }})
- For past research topics → use search_memories

## YOUR ROLE:
- Web researcher, location finder, developer tool specialist
- Find current information, places, code, and data
- Synthesize multiple sources into clear, cited summaries
- Thailand-aware: default to Bangkok timezone and Thai context

## TOOLS:
web_search (brave+wikipedia+fetch_url), get_weather, maps_search,
dev_tools (github+npm+pypi+http_test), rag_search, search_memories, think

## PROCESS:
1. Use rag_search first for user's personal knowledge base
2. Use search_memories for past conversations
3. Use web_search for current public information
4. Synthesize → cite sources clearly

parameters.name: search_memories
parameters.description: Search past conversations and memories semantically. Use when user asks about past experiences, research topics they explored.
parameters.jsCode: const input=JSON.parse($input.first().json.query||'{}');const query=input.query||input.q||'';const limit=input.limit||3;const ctx=$('Load Credentials').first().json;const creds=ctx.credentials||{};const i18n=ctx.i18n||{};const userId=ctx.userId;const dbUrl=creds.database_url||$env.DATABASE_URL||'';const persona=ctx._persona||ctx.persona||{};const tokens=persona.tokens||{};const embedKey=tokens.openrouter_access_token||$env.OPENROUTER_API_KEY||'';if(!dbUrl)return{json:{error:`Database ${i18n.not_connected||'not connected'}`,memories:[]}};if(!query||query.length<3)return{json:{error:'Query too short',memories:[]}};if(!embedKey)return{json:{error:'OpenRouter key not configured',memories:[]}};try{const embedRes=await fetch('https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/embeddings',{method:'POST',headers:{'Authorization':`Bearer ${embedKey}`,'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({model:'openai/text-embedding-3-small',input:query})});if(!embedRes.ok)return{json:{error:`Embed failed: ${embedRes.status}`,memories:[]}};const embedData=await embedRes.json();const embedding=embedData.data?.[0]?.embedding;if(!embedding)return{json:{error:'No embedding returned',memories:[]}};const{Pool}=require('pg');const pool=new Pool({connectionString:dbUrl});const vectorStr=`[${embedding.join(',')}]`;const result=await pool.query(`SELECT content, metadata, created_at, 1 - (embedding <=> $1::vector) AS similarity FROM user_data_schema.memory_embeddings WHERE user_id = $2 AND embedding IS NOT NULL AND 1 - (embedding <=> $1::vector) > 0.6 ORDER BY embedding <=> $1::vector LIMIT $3`,[vectorStr,userId,limit]);await pool.end();const memories=result.rows.map(r=>({content:r.content,similarity:parseFloat(r.similarity.toFixed(3)),metadata:r.metadata||{},date:new Date(r.created_at).toLocaleDateString('th-TH')}));if(memories.length===0)return{json:{message:'No relevant memories found',memories:[],query}};return{json:{memories,count:memories.length,query}};}catch(err){return{json:{error:`${i18n.error||'Error'}: ${err.message}`,memories:[]}};}

parameters.name: web_search
parameters.description: Search the web or fetch content. search_type: brave_search (requires: query), wikipedia (requires: query), fetch_url (requires: url).
parameters.jsCode: const input=JSON.parse($input.first().json.query||'{}');const ctx=$('Load Credentials').first().json;const creds=ctx.credentials||{};const i18n=ctx.i18n||{};const searchType=(input.search_type||'brave_search').toLowerCase();try{if(searchType==='brave_search'){if(!input.query)return{json:{error:i18n.query_required||'query required'}};const braveKey=creds.brave_api_key||$env.BRAVE_API_KEY||'';if(!braveKey)return{json:{error:`Brave API key ${i18n.not_connected}`,help:i18n.configure}};const count=input.count||8;const res=await fetch(`https://api.search.brave.com/res/v1/web/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(input.query)}&count=${count}&country=th`,{headers:{'Accept':'application/json','X-Subscription-Token':braveKey}});if(!res.ok)throw new Error(`Brave API HTTP ${res.status}`);const data=await res.json();const results=(data.web?.results||[]).map(r=>({title:r.title,url:r.url,snippet:r.description?.slice(0,300)}));return{json:{query:input.query,results,count:results.length,engine:'Brave'}};}if(searchType==='wikipedia'){if(!input.query)return{json:{error:i18n.query_required||'query required'}};const wikiLangMap={th:'th',en:'en',ja:'ja',zh:'zh'};const wikiLang=wikiLangMap[input.lang||ctx.lang||'th']||'en';const title=encodeURIComponent(input.query.replace(/ /g,'_'));const res=await fetch(`https://${wikiLang}.wikipedia.org/api/rest_v1/page/summary/${title}`);if(res.status===404){const res2=await fetch(`https://en.wikipedia.org/api/rest_v1/page/summary/${title}`);if(res2.status===404)return{json:{error:`Wikipedia: '${input.query}' not found`}};const data2=await res2.json();return{json:{title:data2.title,summary:data2.extract,url:data2.content_urls?.desktop?.page,lang:'en',note:'Fallback to English'}};}const data=await res.json();return{json:{title:data.title,summary:data.extract,url:data.content_urls?.desktop?.page,lang:wikiLang}};}if(searchType==='fetch_url'){if(!input.url)return{json:{error:i18n.url_required||'url required'}};const res=await fetch(input.url,{headers:{'User-Agent':'JARVIS-Explorer/5.0'}});if(!res.ok)return{json:{error:`HTTP ${res.status}`,url:input.url}};const text=await res.text();const clean=text.replace(/<[^>]+>/g,' ').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim().slice(0,4000);return{json:{url:input.url,content:clean,length:clean.length}};}return{json:{error:`Unknown search_type: ${searchType}. Use: brave_search, wikipedia, fetch_url`}};}catch(e){return{json:{error:`${i18n.error||'Error'}: ${e.message}`}};}

parameters.name: get_weather
parameters.description: Get weather data. weather_type: current, forecast_5day. Requires: city.
parameters.jsCode: const input=JSON.parse($input.first().json.query||'{}');const ctx=$('Load Credentials').first().json;const creds=ctx.credentials||{};const i18n=ctx.i18n||{};const weatherType=(input.weather_type||'current').toLowerCase();const city=input.city||ctx._persona?.location||'Bangkok';const owmKey=creds.openweathermap_key||$env.OPENWEATHERMAP_API_KEY||'';if(!owmKey)return{json:{error:`OpenWeatherMap ${i18n.not_connected}`,help:i18n.configure}};if(!city)return{json:{error:i18n.city_required||'city is required'}};const owmLangMap={th:'th',en:'en',ja:'ja',zh:'zh_cn'};const owmLang=owmLangMap[ctx.lang||'th']||'en';const BASE='https://api.openweathermap.org/data/2.5';try{if(weatherType==='current'){const res=await fetch(`${BASE}/weather?q=${encodeURIComponent(city)}&appid=${owmKey}&units=metric&lang=${owmLang}`);const d=await res.json();if(d.cod!==200)return{json:{error:d.message,city}};return{json:{city:d.name,country:d.sys?.country,temp_c:d.main?.temp,feels_like:d.main?.feels_like,humidity_pct:d.main?.humidity,description:d.weather?.[0]?.description,wind_kph:Math.round((d.wind?.speed||0)*3.6),visibility_km:(d.visibility||0)/1000,timestamp:new Date().toISOString()}};}if(weatherType==='forecast_5day'){const res=await fetch(`${BASE}/forecast?q=${encodeURIComponent(city)}&appid=${owmKey}&units=metric&lang=${owmLang}&cnt=40`);const d=await res.json();if(d.cod!=='200')return{json:{error:d.message,city}};const byDay={};for(const item of d.list){const day=item.dt_txt.split(' ')[0];if(!byDay[day])byDay[day]=[];byDay[day].push(item);}const forecast=Object.entries(byDay).slice(0,5).map(([date,items])=>({date,temp_max:Math.round(Math.max(...items.map(i=>i.main.temp_max))),temp_min:Math.round(Math.min(...items.map(i=>i.main.temp_min))),description:items[Math.floor(items.length/2)].weather[0].description,rain_chance:Math.round(Math.max(...items.map(i=>(i.pop||0)*100)))}));return{json:{city:d.city?.name,forecast,days:forecast.length}};}return{json:{error:`Unknown weather_type: ${weatherType}. Use: current, forecast_5day`}};}catch(e){return{json:{error:`${i18n.error||'Error'}: ${e.message}`}};}

parameters.name: maps_search
parameters.description: Find places or search YouTube. search_type: text_search, nearby, youtube.
parameters.jsCode: const input=JSON.parse($input.first().json.query||'{}');const ctx=$('Load Credentials').first().json;const creds=ctx.credentials||{};const i18n=ctx.i18n||{};const searchType=(input.search_type||'text_search').toLowerCase();try{if(searchType==='text_search'){const mapsKey=creds.google_maps_key||$env.GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY||'';if(!mapsKey)return{json:{error:`Google Maps API key ${i18n.not_connected}`,help:i18n.configure}};if(!input.query)return{json:{error:i18n.query_required||'query required'}};const lat=ctx._persona?.lat||'13.7563';const lng=ctx._persona?.lng||'100.5018';const mapsLang=['th','en','ja','zh'].includes(ctx.lang)?ctx.lang:'en';const res=await fetch(`https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/place/textsearch/json?query=${encodeURIComponent(input.query)}&location=${lat},${lng}&radius=5000&language=${mapsLang}&key=${mapsKey}`);const data=await res.json();if(data.status!=='OK'&&data.status!=='ZERO_RESULTS')return{json:{error:data.status,message:data.error_message}};const places=(data.results||[]).slice(0,5).map(p=>({name:p.name,address:p.formatted_address,rating:p.rating,open_now:p.opening_hours?.open_now,place_id:p.place_id}));return{json:{query:input.query,places,count:places.length}};}if(searchType==='nearby'){const mapsKey=creds.google_maps_key||$env.GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY||'';if(!mapsKey)return{json:{error:`Google Maps API key ${i18n.not_connected}`}};if(!input.query)return{json:{error:i18n.query_required||'query required'}};const lat=input.lat||ctx._persona?.lat||13.7563;const lng=input.lng||ctx._persona?.lng||100.5018;const radius=input.radius||1000;const mapsLang=['th','en','ja','zh'].includes(ctx.lang)?ctx.lang:'en';const res=await fetch(`https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/place/nearbysearch/json?location=${lat},${lng}&radius=${radius}&keyword=${encodeURIComponent(input.query)}&language=${mapsLang}&key=${mapsKey}`);const data=await res.json();const places=(data.results||[]).slice(0,5).map(p=>({name:p.name,vicinity:p.vicinity,rating:p.rating,open_now:p.opening_hours?.open_now}));return{json:{query:input.query,places,count:places.length,radius_m:radius}};}if(searchType==='youtube'){const ytKey=creds.youtube_api_key||$env.YOUTUBE_API_KEY||'';if(!ytKey)return{json:{error:`YouTube API key ${i18n.not_connected}`}};if(!input.query)return{json:{error:i18n.query_required||'query required'}};const maxResults=input.max_results||5;const res=await fetch(`https://www.googleapis.com/youtube/v3/search?part=snippet&q=${encodeURIComponent(input.query)}&maxResults=${maxResults}&type=video&key=${ytKey}`);const data=await res.json();if(data.error)return{json:{error:data.error.message}};const videos=(data.items||[]).map(v=>({title:v.snippet.title,channel:v.snippet.channelTitle,description:v.snippet.description?.slice(0,150),url:`https://youtube.com/watch?v=${v.id.videoId}`,published:v.snippet.publishedAt}));return{json:{query:input.query,videos,count:videos.length}};}return{json:{error:`Unknown search_type: ${searchType}. Use: text_search, nearby, youtube`}};}catch(e){return{json:{error:`${i18n.error||'Error'}: ${e.message}`}};}

parameters.name: dev_tools
parameters.description: Developer tools. tool_type: github_repos, github_issues, github_search, npm_search, pypi_info, http_test.
parameters.jsCode: const input=JSON.parse($input.first().json.query||'{}');const ctx=$('Load Credentials').first().json;const creds=ctx.credentials||{};const i18n=ctx.i18n||{};const toolType=(input.tool_type||'github_search').toLowerCase();const ghToken=creds.github_token||$env.GITHUB_TOKEN||'';const ghHeaders={'Accept':'application/vnd.github.v3+json','User-Agent':'JARVIS-Explorer/5.0',...(ghToken?{'Authorization':`Bearer ${ghToken}`}:{})};try{if(toolType==='github_repos'){const username=ctx._persona?.github_username||input.username||'';if(!username)return{json:{error:i18n.github_username_missing||'github_username not set in persona'}};const res=await fetch(`https://api.github.com/users/${username}/repos?sort=updated&per_page=15`,{headers:ghHeaders});const data=await res.json();if(!Array.isArray(data))return{json:{error:data.message||`GitHub API ${i18n.error}`}};return{json:{repos:data.map(r=>({name:r.name,description:r.description,stars:r.stargazers_count,language:r.language,updated:r.updated_at?.split('T')[0],url:r.html_url})),count:data.length}};}if(toolType==='github_issues'){if(!input.repo)return{json:{error:i18n.repo_required||'repo required (e.g. user/repo)'}};const state=input.state||'open';const res=await fetch(`https://api.github.com/repos/${input.repo}/issues?state=${state}&per_page=15`,{headers:ghHeaders});const data=await res.json();if(!Array.isArray(data))return{json:{error:data.message||`GitHub API ${i18n.error}`}};const issues=data.filter(i=>!i.pull_request).map(i=>({number:i.number,title:i.title,state:i.state,created:i.created_at?.split('T')[0],url:i.html_url}));return{json:{repo:input.repo,issues,count:issues.length}};}if(toolType==='github_search'){if(!input.query)return{json:{error:i18n.query_required||'query required'}};const type=input.type||'repos';const endpoint=type==='code'?'code':type==='users'?'users':'repositories';const res=await fetch(`https://api.github.com/search/${endpoint}?q=${encodeURIComponent(input.query)}&sort=stars&per_page=8`,{headers:ghHeaders});if(!res.ok)throw new Error(`GitHub API HTTP ${res.status}`);const data=await res.json();if(type==='repos')return{json:{results:(data.items||[]).map(r=>({name:r.full_name,description:r.description?.slice(0,200),stars:r.stargazers_count,language:r.language,url:r.html_url})),total:data.total_count}};return{json:{results:(data.items||[]).slice(0,8),total:data.total_count,type}};}if(toolType==='npm_search'){if(!input.query)return{json:{error:i18n.query_required||'query required'}};const res=await fetch(`https://registry.npmjs.org/-/v1/search?text=${encodeURIComponent(input.query)}&size=5`);const data=await res.json();return{json:{packages:(data.objects||[]).map(o=>({name:o.package.name,version:o.package.version,description:o.package.description,url:`https://npmjs.com/package/${o.package.name}`})),count:data.objects?.length||0}};}if(toolType==='pypi_info'){if(!input.package)return{json:{error:i18n.package_required||'package name required'}};const res=await fetch(`https://pypi.org/pypi/${input.package}/json`);if(res.status===404)return{json:{error:`Package '${input.package}' not found on PyPI`}};const data=await res.json();const info=data.info;return{json:{name:info.name,version:info.version,summary:info.summary,author:info.author,license:info.license,home_page:info.home_page,requires_python:info.requires_python}};}if(toolType==='http_test'){if(!input.url)return{json:{error:i18n.url_required||'url required'}};const method=(input.method||'GET').toUpperCase();const startTime=Date.now();const res=await fetch(input.url,{method,headers:{'User-Agent':'JARVIS-Explorer/5.0',...(input.headers||{})},body:input.body?JSON.stringify(input.body):undefined});const duration=Date.now()-startTime;const text=await res.text();let body;try{body=JSON.parse(text);}catch{body=text.slice(0,500);}return{json:{url:input.url,method,status:res.status,ok:res.ok,duration_ms:duration,response:body}};}return{json:{error:`Unknown tool_type: ${toolType}. Use: github_repos, github_issues, github_search, npm_search, pypi_info, http_test`}};}catch(e){return{json:{error:`${i18n.error||'Error'}: ${e.message}`}};}

parameters.name: rag_search
parameters.description: Search user's personal knowledge base using semantic similarity. Use FIRST before web_search for personal notes or saved articles.
parameters.jsCode: const input=JSON.parse($input.first().json.query||'{}');const ctx=$('Load Credentials').first().json;const creds=ctx.credentials||{};const i18n=ctx.i18n||{};const userId=ctx.userId;if(!input.query)return{json:{error:i18n.query_required||'query required'}};const dbUrl=creds.database_url||$env.DATABASE_URL||'';const persona=ctx._persona||ctx.persona||{};const tokens=persona.tokens||{};const embedKey=tokens.openrouter_access_token||$env.OPENROUTER_API_KEY||'';if(!dbUrl)return{json:{error:`Database ${i18n.not_connected||'not connected'}`,results:[]}};try{if(embedKey){const embedRes=await fetch('https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/embeddings',{method:'POST',headers:{'Authorization':`Bearer ${embedKey}`,'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({model:'openai/text-embedding-3-small',input:input.query})});if(embedRes.ok){const embedData=await embedRes.json();const embedding=embedData.data?.[0]?.embedding;if(embedding&&Array.isArray(embedding)){const{Pool}=require('pg');const pool=new Pool({connectionString:dbUrl});const vectorStr=`[${embedding.join(',')}]`;const result=await pool.query(`SELECT content, metadata, 1 - (embedding <=> $1::vector) AS similarity FROM user_data_schema.knowledge_base WHERE user_id = $2 AND embedding IS NOT NULL AND 1 - (embedding <=> $1::vector) > 0.5 ORDER BY embedding <=> $1::vector LIMIT 5`,[vectorStr,userId]);await pool.end();return{json:{results:result.rows||[],count:result.rows.length,mode:'vector'}};}}}console.log('[rag_search] fallback to keyword search');const{Pool}=require('pg');const pool=new Pool({connectionString:dbUrl});const result=await pool.query(`SELECT content, metadata FROM user_data_schema.knowledge_base WHERE user_id = $1 AND content ILIKE $2 LIMIT 5`,[userId,`%${input.query}%`]);await pool.end();return{json:{results:result.rows||[],count:result.rows.length,mode:'keyword_fallback'}};}catch(e){return{json:{error:`${i18n.error||'Error'}: ${e.message}`,results:[]}};}

const raw=$input.first().json;const out=raw.output||raw.agentOutput||raw.text||raw.message||'ไม่พบข้อมูล';const prev=$('Extract Payload').item.json;return{json:{...prev,message:out,response:out,output:out,agentOutput:out,agentCategory:'explorer',processedAt:new Date().toISOString(),_llm_tier:raw._llm_tier||'langchain'}};
